acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:8738b34f-.title: Product GRC Subject Matter Expert, (V4G)
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:8738b34f-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Vanta for Government (V4G) is how we bring that mission to the public sector. As federal compliance undergoes its biggest shift in a decade — FedRAMP 20x, machine-readable authorization, OSCAL — we're building the platform that turns federal frameworks into automated, continuously monitored product experiences. The GRC Subject Matter Experts on this team are the people who make that possible. As Vanta's GRC Subject Matter Expert for V4G, you'll own federal compliance content used by every customer pursuing or maintaining federal authorization on our platform. This is an interpretation-and-authoring role, not a compliance program administration role: your job is to interpret underlying control requirements, identify where FedRAMP modifies or constrains the NIST framework, and translate those interpretations into precise, technically testable guidance that engineering can build and customers can act on. The content you write ships as product — a five-person startup and a Fortune 100 CSP both receive it — so calibrating depth, precision, and universality is the core craft. You'll join Vanta's Security organization, which directly influences product development, facilitates the creation of automated GRC solutions for customers, and provides expert advisory services across the company. What you’ll do as a V4G GRC SME at Vanta: - Build and own federal compliance frameworks — Lead the creation, enhancement, and lifecycle management of controls, evidence requirements, and implementation guidance for FedRAMP (Low/Moderate/High), NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, DFARS, and StateRAMP. Author clear control rationales, acceptance criteria, and customer-facing guidance shipped as out-of-the-box product content. - Interpret controls at the mechanics level — Work fluently with 800-53A assessment procedures and 800-53B baselines; resolve organization-defined parameters and FedRAMP's constraints on them; decompose controls into distinct technical obligations; correctly resolve inherited, shared, and customer-owned responsibilities within a customer responsibility matrix; and anchor evidence expectations in authoritative artifacts (PPSM, STIG and CIS hardening standards and their scan outputs across operating systems, databases, network devices, and endpoints). - Author automated tests & continuous monitoring — Translate controls and infrastructure context (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, GCP, SaaS, endpoints, CI/CD) into spec-level automated tests and detectors. Define test logic, data sources, edge cases, and — critically — failure conditions: how unapproved items, exceptions, missing data, and unevaluated resources affect a result. Pair with Engineering to implement and maintain detectors with versioned framework mappings. - Lead V4G's machine-readable future — Shape how Vanta's federal content is architected for OSCAL and FedRAMP 20x: machine-readable SSPs, config-as-compliance, and continuous authorization workflows. - Design crosswalks and mappings — Maintain bidirectional crosswalks across federal frameworks (800-53 ↔ 800-171 ↔ CMMC ↔ StateRAMP) with canonical control IDs, mapping confidence, and traceability to source authority. - Act as a product advisor across discovery & design — Partner with the V4G PM and Design on feature discovery, review UI/UX for control, evidence, and authorization workflows, and author PRDs and acceptance criteria grounded in agency, auditor, and 3PAO needs. - Enable AI-assisted compliance — Partner with Engineering/ML to design LLM-powered guidance and automation for federal workflows. cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:4d.title: Outside Sales Representative
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:4d.description: Position Summary The Outside Sales & Business Development Representative is responsible for generating new business, strengthening referral relationships, increasing quote conversion, and helping the company grow profitable revenue. This is a full-time, field-based sales role focused on building relationships with commercial accounts, fleet operators, insurance agents, dealerships, body shops, rental companies, municipalities, and other organizations that own, manage, insure, or service vehicles. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, accountable, and comfortable turning daily sales activity into measurable results. Success in this role will be measured by qualified opportunities, follow-up discipline, booked jobs, revenue growth, gross profit contribution, and the ability to help create more predictable, profitable, and collectible work.
responsibilities: Business Development & New Account Growth
Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities across commercial, fleet, insurance-agent, dealership, body shop, rental, municipal, and local business channels.
Build a prioritized target list of companies and referral sources that can generate recurring or repeat auto glass work.
Conduct regular outside sales visits, calls, emails, and follow-up activity to build pipeline and create new opportunities.
Develop relationships with decision-makers, influencers, office staff, service managers, insurance agents, fleet managers, and business owners.
Promote the value proposition around quality installation, local accountability, technical expertise, customer service, and convenience.
Support growth in commercial and fleet accounts by identifying companies that own, lease, insure, or manage multiple vehicles.
Help develop and promote referral programs, fleet inspection opportunities, and other revenue-generating initiatives.
Referral Source & Relationship Management
Strengthen relationships with existing insurance agents, dealerships, body shops, and referral partners.
Identify which agents, accounts, and referral sources are actually producing leads, booked jobs, and revenue.
Follow up consistently with referral sources to maintain visibility, reinforce trust, and increase repeat business.
Track referral activity and communicate customer or account feedback to leadership.
Support customer retention by ensuring follow-up after completed work where appropriate.
Sales Process, Follow-Up & Conversion
Follow up on open quotes, lost quotes, referral opportunities, and direct customer inquiries.
Track why opportunities are won or lost and identify ways to improve conversion.
Coordinate with internal team members to ensure customer expectations, scheduling needs, and job details are communicated clearly.
Ensure sales activity turns into measurable outcomes, including booked jobs, revenue, gross profit, and repeat opportunities.
Maintain disciplined daily and weekly sales activity, including calls, emails, in-person visits, follow-ups, and reporting.
qualifications: Required
Proven ability to build relationships and generate new business.
Strong communication, follow-up, and interpersonal skills.
Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a field-based sales role.
Organized and able to manage multiple prospects, accounts, and follow-up commitments.
Comfortable making calls, sending emails, conducting in-person visits, and asking for business.
Ability to track activity and report results consistently.
Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
Willingness to travel locally throughout the Denver foothills markets.
Preferred
Experience in outside sales, business development, account management, or relationship-based selling.
Experience selling to commercial accounts, fleet operators, insurance agents, dealerships, body shops, contractors, municipalities, or local businesses.
Familiarity with auto glass, automotive services, insurance claims, commercial services, or field-service businesses.
Experience using CRM systems, sales trackers, or pipeline management tools.
Marketing, branding, social media, or collateral-support experience.
Ability to understand basic margin, revenue, and customer profitability concepts.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:6424c933-6c2.title: French Canadian Accessibility Tester
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:6424c933-6c2.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. About the Role Welocalize is expanding its network of accessibility testers to validate the language-specific accessibility of localized digital content: web pages, applications, and documents. You will serve as a native-language expert reviewer, confirming that accessibility elements not only survive translation but are accurate, understandable, and functional in the target language. This role requires fluency in the target language, hands-on experience with assistive technology in that language, and familiarity with Digital Accessibility standards and guidelines such as PDF/UA, WCAG 2.1 & 2.2, and EN 301 549 to complement accessibility testing done internally. Work is assigned on a project basis. You will receive a defined scope, a testing checklist, and access credentials. Findings are reported in a structured defect log and specific bug tracking system. What You Will Do The actual scope will vary by assignment, but the general extent of this role is outlined below. Language Validation: Confirm correct language codes in HTML and PDF metadata, and identify mixed-language content missing proper declarations. In-Language Screen Reader Testing: Using native-language screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, or Narrator), review translated accessible text — including hidden elements, tooltips, error messages, alt text, and UI labels — for accuracy, natural phrasing, and clarity when read aloud. Multimedia Accessibility Review: Evaluate captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions for accuracy, synchronization, and natural language, and confirm multimedia controls are properly labeled in the target language. Defect Reporting: Log findings with WCAG/PDF-UA references, supporting screenshots or recordings, and severity classifications; participate in review calls with the QA Lead as needed. What We Are Looking For Required Native or near-native fluency in French Canadian; you are the authoritative voice on whether translated content reads naturally and is understandable. Demonstrated hands-on experience testing digital content with assistive technology/AT. Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 AA and EN 301 549. Ability to evaluate content from a native-speaker accessibility perspective — not just technical compliance, but real-world usability for screen reader users who speak the language. Reliable access to relevant devices and operating systems to replicate real-world usage in the target locale. Nice to have Strong written communication skills in English for defect reporting and general communications. Experience with PDF accessibility testing using PAC 3 or Adobe Acrobat Pro Accessibility Checker. Familiarity with internationalization, localization, and translation workflows; understanding of how accessibility elements can be affected during format conversion. Personal use of assistive technology. Tools and Environment Welocalize provides access credentials and a structured test plan per engagement. Testers are expected to supply their own device and assistive technology setup appropriate to the target locale. Commonly used tools in this role include: Screen readers: JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), TalkBack (Android), Narrator (Windows) Browser/screen reader pairings aligned to the target locale's most common usage patterns Caption and transcript review: native video players, .srt/.vtt file review PDF accessibility: PAC 3, Adobe Acrobat Pro (provided where required) Defect logging: Jira bug tracking system is most frequently used What to Expect Assignments are project-based with clear scope documents, test checklists, and agreed turnaround timelines prov
